༄༅/ /klong chen snying gi thig le las/bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba'i las byang bklag chog tu bsdebs pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// klong chen snying gi thig le las/ bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba'i las byang bklag chog tu bsdebs pa bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru kro dhā ya/ rigs kun khyab bdag thod phreng rtsal// gdug can gnyen por rab 'bar ba'i// phyag rgya mos pas mchog bsnyen nas// phrin las bklags pas grub par bsdeb// 'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa 'o// dang po las kyi sbyor ba ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i steng du phur bu tshad ldan sgrub pa'i rten du bkod/ sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi mchod spyi ltar bsham/ dbang gi skabs dbang chog tu bshad pa ltar 'du byas la/ phrin las kyi rim pa ni/ gzhung las/ sngon rjes rig 'dzin gzhung ltar byaḥ zhes gsungs pa'i don skabs su babs pa'i kha bsgyur dang bcas te 'god pa la/ thog mar dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro las skyabs sems tshogs gsog ni/ na moḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kunaḥ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma dngaḥ drag po rta khyung dkyil 'khor laḥ snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchiḥ lan gsum/ hoḥ drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nasaḥ pha ma 'gro drug sems can kunaḥ tshad med snying rjes sgrol ba'i phyiraḥ smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyedaḥ lan gsum/ hoḥ ye shes dbyings las sprul pa'i lhar// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul nyes sgrib bshags// dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskul// rtag par bzhugs gsol dge tshogs kun// bla med chos dbyings chen por bsngo// bgegs bskrad bka' bsgo niḥ rang nyid skad cig gis bla ma drag po'i skur gyur/ byin rlabs sogs spyi ltar byas la/ hrīḥ snod bcud sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ glags lta bar gcod gdon gyi rigasaḥ gtor ma longs la gzhan du dengasaḥ bka' las 'das na rdo rjes gzhomaḥ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang thun gyis gziraḥ srung 'khor ni/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams laḥ bgegs dang bar gcod ming yang medaḥ glo bur rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i gdonaḥ chos dbyings ngang du mtshams gcad doḥ byin 'beb ni/

hūm̐ḥ drag po rta khyung lha tshogs rnamasaḥ chos sku'i klong nas thugs rje skyedaḥ longs sku'i rnam rol cir yang sgyuraḥ sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor brten par bcasaḥ dbang skur byin phob rtags mtshan stonaḥ rtsa sngags oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭaḥ ces mthar/ sarba sa ma ya a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃḥ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i sprinaḥ ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kunaḥ kun bzang rnam 'phrul chen por gyuraḥ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ sngags lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i thogs mar dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥ rnam thar gsum ldan stong pa nyidaḥ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can laḥ dmigs med snying rje chen po'i gdangasaḥ nam mkhas gar khyab pad+ma 'odaḥ dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khangaḥ rnam par byang ba'i chos rnams rdzogasaḥ de dbus pad+ma nyi zla dngaḥ ma rig las gyur rten 'brel gdonaḥ dug sbrul bcu gnyis bsnol ba'i stengasaḥ rang rig hrīḥdamar yongs gyur lasaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs zhabs gnyis bgradaḥ sku mdog dmar po gsang phod mthingaḥ stag sham rus rgyan thod phreng brjidaḥ thod skam dbu rgyan ral pa'i gsebaḥ rta mgo ljang zhur khyung gdong dmaraḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon me khyungaḥ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyangaḥ khyung gi tshwa tshwas gtams shing 'phroḥ gnod byed sde brgyad thal bar rlogaḥ ye shes me dpung klong na brjidaḥ tshogs brgyad las gyur ma rig gdonaḥ klu chen brgyad po 'dar zhing 'dudaḥ gtso bo'i spyi mgrin snying ga ruḥ 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsungaḥ yang dag rdo rje thod khrag 'dzinaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi yi ges mtshanaḥ chos kyi phyag rgya'i 'od zer lasaḥ lhar snang ye shes phyag rgya cheḥ las kyi phyag rgya bzhis drangs nasaḥ dam tshig phyag rgyar dbyer med bstimaḥ

e h+ya hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛsh+ya hoḥ ye shes pa bkug cing gzhug pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ thugs rje'i lcags kyus dbyings nas spyan drang ngoḥ byams pa'i zhags pas rten dang ro gcig bsreḥ dga' ba'i sgrog gis thabs shes mnyam par sbyoraḥ btang snyoms dril bus shin tu brtan par byaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭhaḥ rig pa'i me tog gi phyag ni/ hūm̐ḥ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya cheḥ rang nyid de bzhin nyid dang sbyoraḥ lha dang lta ba mjal ba'i phyagaḥ blang dor med pa'i dbyings la 'dudaḥ na mo na ma hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ dbang po drug la nyer spyod rdzasaḥ yul dang bde chen mnyam par rolaḥ sman gtor rak+ta byang chub semasaḥ sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi 'khor los mchodaḥ rū paḥ shab+daḥ gan+dheḥ ra saḥ spar+sheḥ dharma dhā tu ma hā pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta bho dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa hoḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung bla ma drag po'i skuḥ dgod gshe drag shul rta mchog rol pa'i gsungaḥ snying rje rngams zhi ye shes khyung gi thugasaḥ log 'dren 'dul ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ de nas bzlas pa bya ba la dmigs rim ni/ thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ gi mtharaḥ sngags phreng mgal me bzhin du 'khoraḥ 'od zer me stag lta bu dngaḥ khyung gi tshwa tshwas log 'dren sregaḥ rta skad 'tsher bas stong gsum g.yoḥ snod bcud sbyangs nas rang la bstimaḥ lhar snang phyag rgya chen po'i ngangaḥ zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sems rtse gcig pa dang lhar snang nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭaḥ ces bzla tshad ni gzhung las/ grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag nyi shu laḥ dus bsnyen rig pas dpag par byaḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// thun mthar mchod bstod bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi las rim rnams kyi dang po tshogs mchod 'bul bar 'dod na/ bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs dang khyad par dam tshig gi rdzas sha chang sogs tshogs par bshams la byin brlab pa ni/

hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ 'phros pas tshogs kyi nyes skyon sbyangasaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥ 'dod yon nam mkha' mnyam par spelaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ 'og min bde chen zhing khams dngaḥ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i glingaḥ khyad par rnga yab dpal gyi riḥ gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs nasaḥ drag po rta khyung lha tshogs rnamasaḥ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ bla ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor dngaḥ ḍāk+ki chos srung dam can laḥ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs mchod 'bulaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ gha na tsakra pū dza khā hiḥ bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nasaḥ gsang sngags theg chen sgor zhugs teḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams paḥ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshagasaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐ḥ ma rig las nyon gzung 'dzin gyisaḥ bskyed pa'i bdag 'dzin ru tra kunaḥ gzugs la phob cig nṛ tri dzaḥ rnam shes chos dbyings klong du phaṭaḥ gzugs phung tshogs kyi 'khor lor rolaḥ ru tra sarba ha la pañca pū dza kha hiḥ 'dir spro na skong bshags rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma la spyi ltar byin brlabs la bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran laḥ gnas pa'i dbang phyug ging laṅkaḥ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad srungasaḥ a+ṣ+tsu+i ṭa bha ling+ta khā hiḥ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig bla ma drag po'i lhaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs laḥ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thulaḥ snod bcud 'byung ba'i rgud pa solaḥ rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa gsosaḥ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ chad mdo yum bka' las 'byung ba ltar cung zad kha bsgyur ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum las 'das kun tu bzangaḥ

rang bzhin rnam dag 'og min duḥ gdan gsum tshang ba'i ston 'khor gyisaḥ gsang chen rdo rje'i chos 'khor bskoraḥ dngos 'dzin dag pa'i lha gnas gsumaḥ rgyud sde 'byung ba'i gnas su bstanaḥ sngags ni las can sprul pa'i ngoraḥ rang bzhin nyid du 'byung ba'i tsheḥ rang snang chos dbyings zhing khams suḥ dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje'i rgyudaḥ o rgyan chen pos byin brlabs shingaḥ bskur thob bral bar zab dgu'i bcudaḥ 'dzad med gter gyi sgo phye tsheḥ 'khrul pa gzhi la dag pa yiḥ rten 'brel bzhin du phrin las mdzodaḥ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan bod khams skyongaḥ ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis rnamasaḥ 'dir byon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhesaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzodaḥ rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ drag po rta khyung dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ log par 'dren pa'i dam sri kunaḥ mnan no theg pa rim dgu'i rgyaḥ nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cigaḥ s+t+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ de nas gtang rag mchod bstod gong nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ drag po sgrub pa'i dam tshig da nangs themasaḥ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la da bab naḥ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dbang bcu'i stobasaḥ da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsolaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥhūm̐ khrom phaṭaḥ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ sgrub rdzas gnas gsum gtug cing dbang blangs/ nongs bshags ni/ hoḥ drag po rta khyung dkyil 'khor duḥ mchod rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa g.yelaḥ ting 'dzin bying rmugs 'thibs la sogasaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsolaḥ ces dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ tshogs mgron brtan bzhugs bya/ bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs rim 'od gsal du bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhinaḥ rang las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ ye shes dbyings su badz+ra muḥ

rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang: bsngo ba smon lam ni/ hoḥ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kunaḥ rnam mkhyen gdod ma'i rgyu ru bsngoḥ bdag sogs 'dus par bcas pa rnamasaḥ tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas shogaḥ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dngaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥ gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel gyisaḥ 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ tshe bsod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ snang ba dbang 'dus bkra shis shogaḥ log 'dren tshar gcod bkra shis shogaḥ snang zhen lha sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogasaḥ sgra grags bde chen sngags su dgaḥ dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur sminaḥ 'ja' lus zang thal bkra shis shogaḥ ces brjod la me tog 'thor ro// 'dis kyang snyigs ma'i gdug can dpung*// nyi mas smag bzhin rab bcom nas// bla ma drag po'i gsang gsum gyi// phyag rgyas khams gsum kun sdom shog /ces nyer mkho khyer bde'i slad du pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyis tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
